title: Appointments
subtitle: Your visits to the PHC doctor
noUpcomingBody: Book a time with the PHC doctor when the PHC has published its hours.
offlineBody: Booking needs the internet because appointment times are live. Connect and try again, or call the PHC.
offlineListBody: Your appointments cannot be loaded without the internet. Connect and try again.
errorBody: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.slot_unavailable: That time is no longer free. Please choose another.
errors.slot_taken: Someone just booked that time. Please choose another.
errors.patient_busy: You already have an appointment at that time.
errors.too_many: You already have 3 upcoming appointments. Cancel one to book another.
errors.too_late: This appointment has already started, so it cannot be changed here. Please call the PHC.
errors.too_early: You can mark this only after the appointment time.
errors.not_active: This appointment is already cancelled or finished.
errors.same_slot: That is the same time as now. Choose a different time.
errors.not_permitted: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.no_doctor: This doctor is not available for booking.
errors.bad_time: Check the times: use HH:MM, and each end must be after its start.
errors.window_too_short: Some hours are shorter than one appointment.

book.title: Book an appointment
book.reasonPlaceholder: For example: BP check, fever for 3 days
book.emptyBodyPhone: The doctors at {{facility}} have not published their hours in the app. Call {{phone}} to book.
book.emptyBodyNoPhone: The doctors at {{facility}} have not published their hours in the app. Please call or visit {{facility}} to book.
book.fullBodyPhone: There are no free times in the next two weeks. Call {{facility}} on {{phone}}.
book.fullBodyNoPhone: There are no free times in the next two weeks. Please call or visit {{facility}}.
book.reminderNote: We will remind you a day before and an hour before.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this appointment?
cancelDialog.body: {{when}} with {{doctor}}. The time will be given to someone else.

rescheduleDialog.title: Move your appointment?
rescheduleDialog.body: From {{from}} to {{to}}. Your old time will be freed.

doctor.title: Appointments
doctor.subtitleDoctor: Your booked patients for the day
doctor.subtitleAdmin: All appointments at the PHC for the day
doctor.emptyBody: Patients can book only the hours you publish.

availability.title: Consultation hours
availability.subtitle: Patients can book only the times published here.
availability.noDoctors: No doctors are registered at this PHC.
availability.nothingPublished: Nothing published yet. Patients are told to call the PHC.
availability.templateNote: Fills the form with typical PHC hours. Nothing is shown to patients until you press Publish.
availability.templateFilled: Form filled. Check it, then press Publish hours.
availability.exceptionsNote: A date here replaces that day's weekly hours.
availability.published: Hours published. Patients can now book these times.
availability.cleared: All hours removed. Patients are told to call the PHC.
availability.invalid: Check the times: use HH:MM, and each end must be after its start.
availability.offline: Publishing hours needs the internet. Connect and try again.
availability.timeZoneNote: All times are India time (IST). Existing bookings are kept when hours change.

unpublishDialog.title: Remove all hours?
unpublishDialog.body: Patients will not be able to book this doctor in the app. Existing bookings stay.
